evals.title: Intake when concern is missing
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Caller did not supply a concern.
- JOURNAL names no specific question.]

Research this for me.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - AskUserQuestion for the specific concern before searching. It must NOT: - Start web search with an empty concern. - Drop a column or rewrite raw data.
expectations: AskUserQuestion for the specific concern before searching.
The response does NOT: Start web search with an empty concern.
The response does NOT: Drop a column or rewrite raw data.

evals.title: Skip intake when concern is supplied
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Concern and domain are in the prompt.]

Research whether a 0.97 Pearson with the target is leakage on
this regression table. Domain is real estate.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run distinct-angle searches (practice, implementation, pitfalls at least). - Produce ranked candidates with confidence and sources. - Write `scratch/research/<slug>.md`. It must NOT: - Re-ask domain and concern. - Drop the correlated column. - Run `pixi add` / `uv add`.
expectations: Run distinct-angle searches (practice, implementation, pitfalls at least).
Produce ranked candidates with confidence and sources.
The response does NOT: Re-ask domain and concern.
The response does NOT: Drop the correlated column.
The response does NOT: Run `pixi add` / `uv add`.
